a: A long-press (or any other unhandled event) during a pin press drops the press without finishing or undoing it
The ring controls stay up after the pointer leaves the canvas
Canceling a pin drag restores the old pin at a screen point, not its world point
The docked pin never draws pressed while a press is held on it
A failed readback after dispose still calls back into the disposed loupe
b: A lens's ring controls stay up after the pointer leaves the canvas
Dropping the pin on a rect lens's ring pins the aim there instead of taking the pin back
Canceling a pin drag restores a screen point, not the world point the pin held
The zoom keeps a canceled drag's factor, and a cancel with coordinates leaves `dragging` set
